csv.ids: canonical nonnegative uint64 decimal strings; no floating conversions
csv.coordinates: finite double; retained in raw archive, not geometry-qualified
csv.size: finite nonnegative synapse footprint; units not synaptic conductance

eligibility.raw: Retain all records, including self connections, unknown/zero endpoints and size<5
eligibility.pairs: Count size>=5 records by ordered root pair; preserve all self/zero/unknown pairs
eligibility.simple_comparison: size>=5, non-self, both endpoints in archived banc_888_id set
eligibility.duplicates: Any duplicate synapse ID blocks qualification; no arbitrary first-row selection

membership.annotated: Known super_class excluding glia, trachea and not_a_neuron
membership.conflicts: root_888 differs from release primary ID, quarantined separately
membership.outside: Endpoint not in archived annotation set; includes 0 as unassigned
membership.proofread: Quality field only, never used as a membership shortcut

independent_check.reader: PyArrow streaming CSV; all raw rows; exact selected root pairs
independent_check.predicate: size>=5, both endpoints in union of exact BANC rosters; include autapses

acceptance: Source lengths and full MD5 match archive
All release IDs unique and metrics sets agree
Strict parse and exact identities; all retained sizes/coordinates finite
All eligible sites accounted in pair sums/partitions
Independent selected-route counts exactly equal imported counts
Simple-table reconciliation reported without changing filters to fit it
stop_rules: Duplicate IDs or invalid values stop downstream graph qualification

resources.spill_limit: 64GB computational scratch; not archive retention cap

unchanged: Existing FlyWire model, checkpoints and all 39 acceptance requirements/statuses
